app.cannot_open: Keel could not open your data

validation.amount: Enter a valid amount, for example 1234.56.
validation.amount_positive: Enter an amount greater than zero.

accounts.name: Name
accounts.currency_locked: Can't be changed once the account has transactions.
accounts.opening_hint: The balance on the opening date. Use a minus sign for an overdraft.
accounts.opening_owed_hint: What you owe on the opening date. Stored as a negative balance.
accounts.empty_body: Add the accounts you use: checking, savings, cash or cards. Balances update as you record transactions.
accounts.balance_note: Balances include all recorded transactions, including future-dated ones. Totals are shown per currency.

categories.name: Name
categories.delete_body: This category isn't used by any transaction. It will be permanently deleted.
categories.delete_in_use_one: {{count}} transaction uses this category. Choose where to move it.
categories.delete_in_use_other: {{count}} transactions use this category. Choose where to move them.
categories.choose_target: Choose a category to move the transactions to.

transactions.to_amount_hint: The accounts use different currencies. Enter the amount that arrived.
transactions.tags_hint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag.
transactions.need_account: Create an account first, then you can record transactions.
transactions.search: Search payee, description, notes or category
transactions.empty_body: Record your first income or expense to start tracking.
transactions.no_match_body: Try a different search or remove some filters.
transactions.delete_body_one: This transaction will be permanently deleted and account balances will update.
transactions.delete_body_other: These {{count}} transactions will be permanently deleted and account balances will update.

onboarding.welcome_body: A private place to track your money. Everything stays encrypted on this device.
onboarding.currency_hint: Totals are shown in this currency. Each account can have its own.
onboarding.account_body: Start with the account you use most. You can add more later.
onboarding.account_name_required: Enter a name for the account.
onboarding.privacy: Keel works offline and never sends your financial data anywhere.
onboarding.lock_body: Require a PIN or password to open Keel. You can change this later in Settings.

settings.base_currency_hint: Used for new accounts and amount filters.
settings.encryption_hint: All data is stored in a SQLCipher database encrypted with AES-256.

key_protection_hint.android-keystore: The database key is wrapped by a non-exportable key in the Android Keystore (hardware-backed on most devices). The data can't be read if the files are copied off the phone.
key_protection_hint.plain: Development build: the database key is stored without hardware protection. Do not use for real data.

charts.no_data: No income or expenses recorded in these months yet.

dashboard.no_accounts_body: Add an account to start tracking your money.
dashboard.missing_rates: Some totals leave out {{currencies}} because no exchange rate is set.
dashboard.no_budgets_body: Set monthly limits for the categories you want to keep an eye on.
dashboard.no_upcoming_body: Add rent, subscriptions or salary to see what's coming.

analytics.need_two_months: Needs at least two months with data.

budgets.applies_from: Applies from {{month}} onwards until you change it.
budgets.remove_body: The budget stops from {{month}}. Earlier months keep their history.
budgets.limit_hint: Spending in subcategories counts towards this limit.
budgets.rollover: Carry unused budget into next month
budgets.rollover_hint: Only what's left over is carried. Overspending is not.
budgets.empty_body: Set a monthly limit for a category or for all spending. Keel warns you at 80% and when you go over.

recurring.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.start_hint: Monthly items repeat on this day; short months use their last day.
recurring.delete_body: Future occurrences are removed. Transactions already recorded are kept.
recurring.empty_body: Track rent, bills, subscriptions, loan payments and salary. Keel lists what's due and you record each one with a tap.
recurring.nothing_upcoming: Nothing else in the next 30 days.

goals.name: Name
goals.track_manual_hint: Record money you set aside for this goal.
goals.track_account_hint: Progress follows the balance of a savings account.
goals.needed_per_month: Save {{amount}} a month to reach it by {{date}}.
goals.linked_note: Progress follows the balance of {{account}}. Add money to that account to move this goal forward.
goals.empty_body: Set a target, like an emergency fund or a holiday, and track your progress.
goals.delete_body: "{{name}}" and its contribution history will be permanently deleted.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.intro: Totals are shown in {{base}}. Keel never downloads rates; enter the rates you want to use. Each rate applies from its date until a newer one.
rates.none_needed: All your accounts use {{base}}, so no rates are needed.

lock.title: Keel is locked
lock.wrong_recovery: That recovery key is not correct.
lock.biometric_failed: Biometric unlock didn't work. Use your PIN or password.
lock.forgot_pin: Forgot your PIN? Use the recovery key
lock.forgot_password: Forgot your password? Use the recovery key
lock.recovery_body: Enter the 32-character key you saved when you set up the lock.
lock.recovery_explain: This is your recovery key. It is the only way back in if you forget your PIN or password.
lock.recovery_warning: Write it down or store it in a password manager. Keel can't show it again, and without it a forgotten PIN means your data can't be recovered.
lock.recovery_ack: I have saved my recovery key
lock.pin_rule: The PIN must be exactly 8 digits.
lock.pin_note: An 8-digit PIN keeps out anyone who picks up your phone. Your data stays encrypted with a key held by Android's secure hardware.
lock.password_note: A long password gives the strongest protection.
lock.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

security.lock_off_hint: Anyone who can unlock this phone can open Keel.
security.turn_off_body: Keel will open without a PIN or password. Your data stays encrypted on this device.
security.new_recovery_body: Your current recovery key will stop working. Confirm with your PIN or password to get a new one.
security.current_wrong: That is not your current PIN or password.
security.biometric_hint: Use a fingerprint or face to unlock. Your PIN or password still works.
security.auto_lock_hint: Locks when you haven't touched the app for this long.
security.background_hint: How long Keel can stay in the background before it locks.
security.hide_switcher_hint: Blanks Keel in the recent-apps view and blocks screenshots.

data.title: Data
data.backup_hint: An encrypted file with all your data. Store it somewhere safe, such as your computer or cloud storage.
data.backup_explain: The backup is encrypted with this password. You'll need it to restore, on this or another phone.
data.backup_warning: Keel can't recover a backup if you forget this password.
data.restore_hint: Replace all data in Keel with the contents of a backup file.
data.restore_explain: Choose a .keelbak file created by Keel.
data.backup_contents: Backup from {{date}} with {{accounts}} accounts and {{transactions}} transactions.
data.restore_warning: Everything currently in Keel will be replaced. This can't be undone. Create a backup first if you might need the current data.
data.csv_hint: A CSV file for spreadsheets. It is not encrypted.
data.delete_hint: Erase every account, transaction and setting from this device.
data.delete_body: This permanently erases all your data and the encryption key from this device. Backup files you saved elsewhere are not affected.
data.wrong_backup_password: Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
data.not_a_backup: This file is not a Keel backup, or it is damaged.
data.report_hint: A one-page PDF summary of a month: income, spending by category, budgets and balances.

import.title: Import bank statement
import.hint: Add transactions from your bank's CSV export. Duplicates are skipped.
import.intro: Export your transactions as CSV from your online banking, then choose the file. You'll match its columns before anything is imported.
import.invert: Expenses are positive numbers in this file
import.rules: Negative amounts become expenses, positive ones income. Rows already in Keel are skipped, and categories are filled in from your earlier transactions with the same payee.
import.done: Imported {{imported}} transactions ({{categorized}} categorised automatically). Skipped {{duplicates}} already in Keel.

autobackup.title: Automatic backups
autobackup.off_hint: Saves an encrypted backup every week to a folder you choose. Keeps the last 5.
autobackup.explain: Choose a folder, for example Documents or a folder your cloud app keeps in sync. Keel saves an encrypted backup there each week when you open the app, and keeps the 5 newest.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Notifications are created on this phone only. On the lock screen they show no details.
reminders.bills: Remind me the day before a bill or payment is due
reminders.budgets: Tell me when a budget reaches 80 % or goes over
reminders.permission_denied: Notifications are blocked for Keel. Allow them in Android settings.

sync.title: Sync with Dropbox
sync.intro: Keep Keel in step on more than one phone. Keel stores one encrypted file in its own Dropbox folder; Dropbox can't read it.
sync.disconnect_body: Keel stops syncing. Your data stays on this phone and the file stays in your Dropbox.
sync.rule: Use one phone at a time: the newest copy wins. If both phones changed, Keel asks which to keep.
sync.conflict: This phone and Dropbox were both changed since the last sync. Choose which copy to keep; the other is replaced.
sync.existing_title: Use your Keel data from Dropbox
sync.new_body: The file in Dropbox is encrypted with this password. You'll enter it once on each other phone.
sync.existing_body: Keel data from another phone was found in your Dropbox. Enter its sync password to use it here.
sync.password_warning: Keel can't recover the Dropbox copy if you forget this password.
sync.replace_warning: The data currently on this phone will be replaced by the Dropbox copy.
